title: orch CLI answers v1: pages, errors, follow streams
description: Shapes every core and add-on command uses with --json (addon-manifest.md, CLI contract). A list command that can grow answers a page; a refusal is exit 2 with an error object on stdout; a --follow command prints one JSON object per line.

next.description: Opaque cursor for --after; null = no more.

page.description: Newest first unless the command says otherwise. --limit N (default 100, max 500) and --after <next>. Unknown fields allowed (e.g. since).

error.description: Plain words for people, key values hidden.

code.description: Optional, for programs. Old commands answer without it. needs_person = a person's own decision (human-proof.md): an agent caller, or no valid proof. changed = the value is no longer the one the caller showed (`--if-current`): nothing was written.

stream_line.description: One line of a --follow stream. Readers skip types they do not know. A line of type error is the last line; the command then exits 2.
